features.title:
Everything you need to
manage volunteering
features.subtitle: We put the joy into volunteer management — for organizations and volunteers alike.
features.card1.title: Smart Opportunity Discovery
features.card1.desc: Filter by cause, location, date, and available slots to find the perfect volunteer fit for your skills and schedule.
features.card2.title: Track Your Impact
features.card2.desc: Log volunteer hours automatically and see how many hours you've contributed to your community over time.
features.card3.title: Direct Messaging
features.card3.desc: Connect directly with organizations, ask questions, and build lasting relationships with your community partners.
features.card4.title: Shift Scheduling
features.card4.desc: See exact start and end times for every opportunity. Know exactly what time commitment you're making before signing up.
features.card5.title: Organization Dashboard
features.card5.desc: Organizations get powerful tools to post opportunities, manage applications, and track volunteer activity in real time.
features.card6.title: AI Assistant
features.card6.desc: Our built-in VolunteerBot answers all your questions about opportunities, slots, applications, and how the platform works.
howItWorks.title: Get started in 3 easy steps
howItWorks.subtitle: It's quick, free, and joins you with a community of people making a real difference.
howItWorks.step1.title: Create Your Account
howItWorks.step1.desc: Sign up as a volunteer or an organization in under 60 seconds. No credit card, no hidden fees — ever.
howItWorks.step2.title: Browse & Apply
howItWorks.step2.desc: Search active opportunities by location, date, and cause. Apply with a single click and wait for confirmation.
howItWorks.step3.title: Show Up & Make Impact
howItWorks.step3.desc: Get notified when your application is approved. Volunteer, track your hours, and build your impact story.
